create_parameter_mutation: create a Parameter instance and call mutate to randomly perturb its internal value
spawn_parameter_child: spawn a child Parameter from an existing one that shares the same random state
recombine_parameters: recombine a Parameter with other Parameter instances to blend their values together
register_constraint_on_parameter: register a cheap constraint function on a Parameter to validate values after mutation
convert_to_parameter: convert any value to a Parameter using as_parameter which wraps non-Parameters as Constants
